1.1: Amazwi ka-Amose owayephakathi kwabelusi baseThekhowa, owabonayo ngo-Israyeli emihleni ka-Uziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, nasemihleni kaJerobowamu indodana kaJowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, iminyaka emibili ngaphambi kokuzamazama komhlaba.
1.2: Wathi: “UJehova uyaduma eseSiyoni, ezwakalise izwi lakhe eseJerusalema; amadlelo abelusi ayakulila, nesiqongo saseKarmeli siyakubuna.”
1.3: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zaseDamaseku, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba babhula iGileyadi ngezibhulo ezibukhali zensimbi.
1.4: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo endlini kaHazayeli, uqede izindlu zobukhosi zikaBeni Hadadi.
1.5: Ngiyakwaphula imigoqo yaseDamaseku, nginqume abakhileyo eBikati Aveni, nophethe intonga eBeti Edene, abantu base-Aramu bathunjelwe eKhiri,” usho uJehova.
1.6: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zaseGaza, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba bathumba abantu ngokuthumba okupheleleyo ukuba babakhaphele ku-Edomi.
1.7: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo ogangeni lwaseGaza, uqede izindlu zalo zamakhosi.
1.8: Ngiyakunquma abakhileyo e-Ashidodi, nophethe intonga e-Ashikeloni, ngiphendulele isandla sami e-Ekroni; nensali yamaFilisti iyakuphela,” isho iNkosi uJehova.
1.9: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zaseTire, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba bakhaphela abantu ngokuthumba okupheleleyo ku-Edomi, bangakhumbuli isivumelwano sabazalwane.
1.10: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo ogangeni lwaseTire, uqede izindlu zalo zamakhosi.”
1.11: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zakwa-Edomi, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba wamxosha umfowabo ngenkemba, walahla isihe sakhe, wagcina ulaka lwakhe, wayilondoloza intukuthelo yakhe.
1.12: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo eThemani, uqede izindlu zamakhosi zaseBosira.”
1.13: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zabantwana bakwa-Amoni, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba baqaqile abakhulelweyo kwaGileyadi ukuba bayenze banzi imikhawulo yabo.
1.14: Kepha ngiyakuphemba umlilo ogangeni lwaseRaba, uqede izindlu zalo zamakhosi ngokumemeza ngosuku lokulwa, nangesiphepho ngosuku lwesivunguvungu.
1.15: Inkosi yabo iyakuya ekuthunjweni, yona nezikhulu zayo kanyekanye,” usho uJehova.

2.1: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zakwaMowabi, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba washisa amathambo enkosi yakwa-Edomi aba ngumcako.
2.2: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo kwaMowabi, uqede izindlu zamakhosi zaseKeriyote, uMowabi afe ngokuxokozela, nangokumemeza, nangokukhala kwecilongo.
2.3: Ngiyakunquma umahluleli phakathi kwakhe, ngibulale zonke izikhulu zakhe kanye naye,” usho uJehova.
2.4: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zakwaJuda, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba bawulahlile umthetho kaJehova, abagcinanga izimiso zakhe, namanga abo abadukisile, abawalandelayo nawoyise.
2.5: Kepha ngiyakuthuma umlilo kwaJuda, uqede izindlu zamakhosi zaseJerusalema.”
2.6: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Ngenxa yeziphambeko ezintathu zakwa-Israyeli, yebo, ngenxa yezine, angiyikuguquka, ngokuba bathengisile olungileyo ngesiliva, nompofu ngamabhangqa ezicathulo.
2.7: Bazondelela amakhanda abampofu ukuba abe sothulini lomhlabathi, bachezukisa indlela yabathobileyo; indoda noyise baya entombininye, ukuze balihlambalaze igama lami elingcwele,
2.8: bacambalale ezingutsheni ezithathwe zaba yisibambiso eceleni kwawo onke ama-altare, baphuze iwayini labahlawulisiweyo endlini kaNkulunkulu wabo.
2.9: “Nokho mina ngachitha ama-Amori ebusweni babo, akuphakama kwawo kwakunjengokuphakama kwemisedari,* ayenamandla njengama-oki;* kepha ngachitha nokho izithelo zawo phezulu nezimpande zawo phansi.
2.10: “Futhi mina nganikhuphula ezweni laseGibithe, nganihambisa iminyaka engamashumi amane ehlane ukuba nidle ifa lezwe lama-Amori.
2.11: Ngavusa kumadodana enu abaprofethi nasezinsizweni zenu amaNaziri.* Akunjalo, nina bantwana bakwa-Israyeli, na?” usho uJehova.
2.13: “Bhekani, ngiyakunicindezela endaweni yenu njengengqukumbane icindezela, igcwele izithungu.
2.14: Onejubane uyakuswela ukubaleka; onamandla akayikuqinisa amandla akhe, neqhawe aliyikuzikhulula.
2.15: Obambe umnsalo akayikuma; onejubane ngezinyawo zakhe kayikuzikhulula, nokhwele ihhashi akayikuzikhulula;
2.16: onesibindi phakathi kwamaqhawe uyakubaleka ze ngalolo suku,” usho uJehova.

3.1: Yizwani leli zwi uJehova alikhulumile ngani bantwana bakwa-Israyeli, ngawo wonke umndeni engawukhuphula ezweni laseGibithe, ngokuthi:
3.2: “Nginazile nina kuphela emindenini yonke yomhlaba; ngalokho ngiyakunihambela ngabo bonke ububi benu.”
3.3: Kuhamba ababili kanyekanye, uma bengavumelananga, na?
3.4: Ingonyama iyabhodla ehlathini, ingenampango, na? Ibongo lengonyama liyezwakalisa izwi lalo emphandwini walo, uma lingabambanga lutho, na?
3.5: Inyoni iwela ogibeni emhlabathini, ingenasihibe, na? Ugibe luyaxhuma emhlabathini, lungabambanga nokubamba, na?
3.6: Kungabethwa icilongo emzini, bangesabi abantu, na? Umuzi ungehlelwa ngokubi, engakwenzamga uJehova, na?
3.7: Ngokuba iNkosi uJehova ayenzi lutho, ingayambulanga imfihlakalo yayo ezincekwini zayo abaprofethi.
3.8: Ingonyama ibhongile, ngubani ongayikwesaba na? INkosi uJehova ikhulumile, ngubani ongayikuprofetha na?
3.9: Zwakalisani ezindlini zamakhosi zase-Ashidodi, nasezindlini zamakhosi zasezweni laseGibithe, nithi: “Buthanani ezintabeni zaseSamariya, nibone izidumo ezinkulu eziphakathi kwalo, nokucindezelwa okukulo.”
3.10: “Ngokuba abakwazi ukwenza okulungileyo,” usho uJehova; “babekelela ubudlova nokuphanga ezindlini zabo zamakhosi.”
3.11: Ngalokho isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: “Isitha siyakulihaqa izwe, sehlise kini izinqaba zenu, ziphangwe izindlu zenu zamakhosi.”
3.12: Usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “Njengalokhu umalusi ophula emlonyeni wengonyama imilenze emibili noma inxenye yendlebe, kanjalo abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bayakophulwa, abahlala eSamariya ezingosini zezihlalo naphezu kwezingubo zikasilika* zemibhede.”
3.13: “Yizwani, nifakaze ngendlu kaJakobe, isho iNkosi uJehova, uNkulunkulu Sebawoti.
3.14: “Ngokuba mhla ngiyakumhambela u-Israyeli ngeziphambeko zakhe, ngiyakuhambela nama-altare aseBethele, kunqunywe izimpondo ze-altare, ziwe phansi.
3.15: Ngiyakushaya indlu yasebusika kanye nendlu yasehlobo, kuphele izindlu zophondo lwendlovu, yebo, izindlu eziningi ziyakuphela,” usho uJehova.

4.1: Yizwani leli zwi, nina zinkomo zaseBashani enisentabeni yaseSamariya, enicindezela abaphansi, enichoboza abampofu, enithi emakhosini enu: “Lethani, siphuze.”
4.2: INkosi uJehova ifungile ubungcwele bayo ukuthi: “Bhekani, izinsuku ziyakunehlela lapho niyakususwa ngezingwegwe, nabaseleyo kini ngezindobo.
4.3: Niyakuphuma emifantwini, kube yilowo nalowo ngoqondene naye, nilahlwe eHermoni,” usho uJehova.
4.4: “Wozani eBethele, niphambeke, naseGiligali, nandise iziphambeko, nilethe imihlatshelo yenu ekuseni njalo, nokweshumi kwenu kanye ngezinsuku ezintathu,
4.5: nishise umnikelo wokubonga ngokuvutshelweyo, nimemezele iminikelo yesihle, niyizwakalise, ngokuba nithanda kanjalo, bantwana bakwa-Israyeli,” isho iNkosi uJehova.
4.6: “Mina nganinika ukuhlanzeka kwamazinyo emizini yenu yonke nokuswela isinkwa kuzo zonke izindawo zenu, kepha anibuyelanga kimi,” usho uJehova.
4.7: “Futhi ngagodla kini imvula, kusasele izinyanga ezintathu ukuba kuvunwe, ngalinisa phezu komunye umuzi, komunye umuzi angilinisanga; esinye isiqephu saniselwa, nesiqephu esinganiselwanga sasha.
4.8: Kwase kuhamba imizi emibili noma emithathu, yaya komunye umuzi ukuyophuza amanzi, kodwa ayaneliswanga; kepha nokho anibuyelanga kimi,” usho uJehova.
4.9: “Nganishaya ngokuhamuka nesikhutha; izivande zenu, nezivini zenu, nemikhiwane yenu, neminqumo yenu eminingi kwadliwa yisibotho, kepha nokho anibuyelanga kimi,” usho uJehova.
4.10: “Nganithumela isifo ngendlela yaseGibithe, ngazibulala izinsizwa zenu ngenkemba, ngathumba amahhashi enu, ngenza ukuba ukunuka kwekamu* lenu kukhuphukele nasemakhaleni enu, kepha nokho anibuyelanga kimi,” usho uJehova.
4.11: “Nganichitha njengalokho uNkulunkulu achitha iSodoma neGomora; naninjengesikhuni esophulwe emlilweni, kepha nokho anibuyelanga kimi,” usho uJehova.
4.12: “Ngalokho ngiyakwenze njalo kuwe Israyeli; njengokuba ngiyakwenza lokhu kuwe, zilungiselele ukuhlangana noNkulunkulu wakho, Israyeli.”
4.13: Ngokuba bheka, owabumba izintaba, nowawudala umoya, otshela umuntu umqondo wakhe, owenza ukusa kube ngubumnyama, onyathela ezindaweni eziphakemeyo zomhlaba, igama lakhe linguJehova, uNkulunkulu Sebawoti.

5.1: Zwanini leli zwi engiliphakamisa phezu kwenu libe yisililo ngendlu ka-Israyeli.
5.2: “Iwile intombi yakwa-Israyeli, ayisayikuvuka; iphonsiwe phansi, akakho ongayivusa.”
5.3: Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: “Umuzi owaphuma uyinkulungwane uyakushiya ikhulu, nowaphuma uyikhulu uyakushiya ishumi kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli.”
5.4: Ngokuba usho kanje uJehova kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: “Ngifuneni, niphile.
5.5: Kepha ningalifuni iBethele, ningangeni eGiligali, ningadluleli eBeri Sheba, ngokuba iGiligali liyakuthunjwa nokuthunjwa, neBethele liyakuba yize.”
5.6: Funani uJehova, niphile, funa afikele indlu kaJosefa njengomlilo, udle, kungekho owucimayo eBethele.
5.7: Nina enihlanekezela ukwahlulela kube ngumhlonyane, nilahle phansi ukulunga;
5.8: nimfune owenza isiLimela neMpambano, ophendula ithunzi lokufa libe ngukusa, ayenze imini ibe mnyama njengobusuku, obiza amanzi olwandle, awathululele ebusweni bomhlaba nguJehova igama lakhe
5.9: owenza ukuchitha ukuba kunyazime phezu kwabanamandla, nencithakalo ukuba yehlele izinqaba.
5.10: Bayamzonda ofakazela ukulunga esangweni; okhuluma ubuqotho banengwa nguye.
5.11: Ngalokho, ngokuba ninyathela abampofu, namukele kuye isipho samabele, noma nakha izindlu ngamatshe abaziweyo aniyikuhlala kuzo, nokuba nitshala izivini ezinhle aniyikuphuza iwayini lazo.
5.12: Ngokuba ngiyazi ukuthi iziphambeko zenu ziningi nokuthi izono zenu zinkulu, nina enicindezela abalungileyo, namukela umvuzo, nenichezukisa abampofu esangweni.
5.13: Ngalokho ohlakaniphileyo uyakuthula ngaleso sikhathi, ngokuba kuyisikhathi esibi lesi.
5.14: Funani okuhle, hhayi okubi, ukuze niphile, abe nani uJehova uNkulunkulu Sebawoti kanjalo, njengalokhu nisho.
5.15: Zondani okubi, nithande okuhle, nimise ukwahlulela esangweni; mhlawumbe uJehova uNkulunkulu Sebawoti uyakuba nomusa kuyo insali yakwaJosefa.
5.16: Ngalokho usho kanje uJehova uNkulunkulu Sebawoti, iNkosi, uthi: “Ezigcawini zonke kuyakuba khona ukukhala, nakuzo zonke izitaladi bayakusho ukuthi: ‘Maye, maye!’ babize umlimi ukuba akhale, nabaziyo izililo ukuba balile;
5.17: nakuzo zonke izivini kuyakuba khona ukukhala, ngokuba ngiyakudlula phakathi kwakho,” usho uJehova.
5.18: Wo kinina enifisa usuku lukaJehova! Luyakunisizani usuku lukaJehova? Lungubumnyama, alusikho ukukhanya.
5.19: Kunjengalokhu umuntu ebalekela ingonyama, kuhlangane naye ibhere,* noma engena endlini encike ngesandla odongeni, alunywe yinyoka.
5.20: Lungubumyama usuku lukaJehova, alusikho ukukhanya, nesigayegaye okungekho kuso ukukhazimula.
5.21: “Ngiyayizonda, ngiyayidelela imikhosi yenu, angenameli imihlangano yenu.
5.22: Noma ninikela kimi ngeminikelo yenu yokushiswa kanye neminikelo yenu yempuphu, angiyenameli, futhi angibheki iminikelo yenu yokubonga yamathole akhuluphalisiweyo.
5.23: Susa kimi umsindo wezihlabelelo zakho, angiyikuzwa imvunge yezingubhu zakho.
5.24: Kepha ukwahlulela makugobhoze njengamanzi, nokulunga njengomfula onganqamukiyo.
5.25: “Naletha kimi imihlatshelo neminikelo yempuphu ehlane iminyaka engamashumi amane, nina ndlu ka-Israyeli, na?
5.26: Seniyakuthwala uSakuti inkosi yenu noKhewani inkanyezi kankulunkulu wenu, izithombe zenu enizenzele zona.
5.27: Ngiyakunenza ukuba nithunjelwe ngaphesheya kweDamaseku,” usho uJehova ogama lakhe linguNkulunkulu Sebawoti.

6.1: Wo kwabazinzileyo eSiyoni, nabalondekile entabeni yaseSamariya, abaqhamileyo besokuqala sezizwe, efika kubo indlu yakwa-Israyeli!
6.2: Dlulelani eKaline, nibone; nisuke lapho, niye eHamati elikhulu, bese nehlela eGati lamaFilisti; bahle kunale mibuso yini, umkhawulo wabo mkhulu kunomkhawulo wenu na?
6.3: nina enidedisela kude usuku olubi, kepha nisondezile isihlalo sobudlova.
6.4: Balele emibhedeni yophondo lwendlovu, bacambalala ezinkukhweni zabo; badla amawundlu omhlambi namathole avela phakathi kwesibaya.
6.5: Bahaya ngomsindo wogubhu, baziqambela izinto zokubethwa njengoDavide.
6.6: Baphuza imikhele yewayini, bazigcoba ngamafutha amahle, kepha abadabuki ngokuchithwa kukaJosefa.
6.7: Ngalokho sebeyakuthunjwa phakathi kwabokuqala abathunjwayo, kusuke ukuxokozela kwabacambalalayo.
6.8: INkosi uJehova izifungile, usho uJehova uNkulunkulu Sebawoti, yathi: “Ngiyanengwa ngukuzidla kukaJakobe, ngizonda izindlu zakhe zamakhosi; ngiyakukhaphela umuzi nokugcwala kwawo.”
6.9: Kuyakuthi uma kusele amadoda ayishumi endlini inye, afe.
6.10: Lapho umngane womuntu emphakamisa kanye noshisayo ukuba bakhiphe amathambo endlini, abesesho kophakathi kwendlu impela ukuthi: “Kusekhona muntu kuwe na?” yena esephendula athi: “Akusekho,” khona wothi: “Thula, ngokuba asinakuthinta igama likaJehova.”
6.11: Ngokuba bhekani, uJehova uyayaleza: uyakushaya indlu enkulu ibe yizihlephu, nendlu encane ibe yizingcezu.
6.12: Amahhashi ayagijima emadwaleni, kulinywa elwandle ngezinkabi, na? Ngokuba niphendulile ukwahlulela kwaba yisihlungu, nezithelo zokulunga zaba ngumhlonyane,
6.13: nina enithokoza ngento engelutho, nithi: “Asizithathelanga izimpondo ngamandla ethu na?”
6.14: “Ngokuba bhekani, ngiyakunivusela isizwe nina ndlu ka-Israyeli,” usho uJehova uNkulunkulu Sebawoti; “bayakunicindezela kusukela ekuyeni eHamati kuze kube semfuleni wase-Araba.”

7.1: INkosi uJehova yangibonisa kanje: bheka, yayenza isikhonyane ekuqaleni kokumila kotshani bamuva; bheka, kwakungutshani bamuva emva kokusika kwenkosi.
7.2: Kwathi lapho sesidlile utshani bezwe, ngathi: “Nkosi Jehova, ake uthethelele; uJakobe uyakuma kanjani, ngokuba mncane.”
7.4: Yayisingibonisa kanje iNkosi uJehova: bheka, iNkosi uJehova yabiza ukulwa ngomlilo; wadla utwa olukhulu, wawusuyakudla futhi isabelo sikaJehova.
7.5: Ngase ngithi: “Nkosi Jehova, mawuyeke; uJakobe uyakuma kanjani, ngokuba mncane.”
7.6: UJehova wazisola ngalokhu. “Akuyikubakho,” isho iNkosi uJehova.
7.7: Wayesengibonisa kanje: bheka, iNkosi yayimi ngasogangeni olwakhiwe ngentambo yomthofu wokumisa, enentambo yomthofu wokumisa esandleni sakhe.
7.8: UJehova wathi kimi: “Amose, ubonani na?” Ngathi: “Intambo yomthofu wokumisa.” Yayisithi iNkosi: “Bhekani, ngiyakubeka intambo yomthofu wokumisa phakathi kwabantu bami u-Israyeli; angisayikubadlula.
7.9: “Izindawo eziphakemeyo zika-Isaka ziyakuchithwa, nezindlu ezingcwele zakwa-Israyeli ziyakuqothulwa, ngivukele indlu kaJerobowamu ngenkemba.”
7.10: U-Amasiya umpristi waseBethele wayesethumela kuJerobowamu inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wathi: “U-Amose ukwenzele ugobe phakathi kwendlu yakwa-Israyeli; izwe alinakuthwala onke amazwi akhe.
7.11: Ngokuba u-Amose ushilo kanje, wathi: “UJerobowamu uyakufa ngenkemba, u-Israyeli athunjwe nokuthunjwa ezweni lakhe.”
7.12: U-Amasiya wayesethi ku-Amose: “Wena mboni, hamba, ubalekele ezweni lakwaJuda, udle khona isinkwa, uprofethe khona;
7.13: ungabe usaqhubeka kodwa ukuprofetha eBethele, ngokuba liyindlu engcwele yenkosi nendlu yombuso.”
7.14: Wayesephendula u-Amose, wathi ku-Amasiya: “Angisiye umprofethi mina, nendodana yomprofethi angisiyo, kepha ngangingumalusi, ngangitshala imithombe.
7.15: Kepha uJehova wangisusa ekulandeleni umhlambi; uJehova wathi kimi: ‘Hamba uprofethe kubantu bami u-Israyeli.’
7.16: Manje yizwa izwi likaJehova lokuthi: Wena uthi: “ ‘Ungaprofethi ngo-Israyeli, ungaconsisi izwi lakho phezu kwendlu ka-Isaka.’
7.17: “Ngalokho usho kanje uJehova, uthi: “ ‘Umkakho uyakufeba emzini, namadodana akho namadodakazi akho ayakuwa ngenkemba, nezwe liyakudatshulwa ngentambo; wena uyakufela ezweni elingcolileyo, u-Israyeli athunjwe nokuthunjwa ezweni lakhe.’ ”

8.1: INkosi uJehova yayisingibonisa kanje: bheka, nanto iqoma lezithelo zasehlobo.
8.2: Yathi: “Amose, ubonani na?” Ngathi: “Iqoma lezithelo zasehlobo.” Wayesethi uJehova kimi: “Ukuphela sekufikile kubantu bami u-Israyeli; angisayikumdlula.
8.3: “Izihlabelelo zethempeli ziyakuba ngukuhhewula ngalolo suku,” isho iNkosi uJehova; “izidumbu ziyakuba ziningi, zilahlwe ezindaweni zonke. Thulani!”
8.4: Yizwani lokhu nina enigwinya abampofu, nenichitha abaswelayo bezwe,
8.5: nithi: “Kuyakudlula nini ukwethwasa kwenyanga ukuba sithengise ngamabele, nesabatha ukuba sikhiphe ukolweni, senze i-efa* libe lincane, senze ishekeli* libe likhulu, senze izilinganiso ukuba zikhohlise,
8.6: ukuze sithenge abampofu ngesiliva nabaswelayo ngamabhangqa ezicathulo, sithengise ngamahlunge kakolweni.”
8.7: UJehova ufungile ukuziqhenya kukaJakobe ngokuthi: “Impela angiyikukhohlwa kuze kube phakade nesisodwa sezenzo zabo.
8.8: “Umhlaba awuyikuqhaqhazela ngalokho, balile bonke abakhileyo kuwo, na? Yebo, uyakukhukhumala wonke njengeNayile, unyakaze, ubuye ubohle njengomfula waseGibithe.
8.9: “Kuyakuthi ngalolo suku,” isho iNkosi uJehova, “ngilishonise ilanga emini, ngenze ukuba kube mnyama emhlabeni emini ekhanyayo.
8.10: Ngiyakuphendula imikhosi yenu ibe ngukukhala, nezihlabelelo zenu zonke zibe yizililo, ngibeke izindwangu zamasaka ezinkalweni zonke, nobumpandla kuwo onke amakhanda, ngikwenze kube njengokulilela indodana eyodwa, ukuphela kwakho kube njengosuku olumunyu.”
8.11: “Bhekani, izinsuku ziyeza,” isho iNkosi uJehova, “lapho ngiyakuthuma indlala ezweni, kungabi yindlala yezinkwa, kungabi ngukomela amanzi, kepha kube ngeyokuzwa amazwi kaJehova.
8.12: Bayakuzulazula kusukela elwandle kuze kube selwandle, kusukela enyakatho kuze kube sempumalanga, bahambahambe ukufuna izwi likaJehova, kepha abayikulifumana.
8.13: “Ngalolo suku izintombi ezinhle nezinsizwa ziyakudangala ukoma.
8.14: Abafunga icala laseSamariya, bathi: ‘Kuphila kukankulunkulu wakho, Dani,’ nokuthi: ‘Kuphila kothandiweyo wakho, Beri Sheba,’ bayakuwa, bangabe besavuka.”

9.1: Ngayibona iNkosi imi ngase-altare, yathi: “Shaya izihloko zezinsika, ukuze imigulugulu izamazame, uzaphule phezu kwamakhanda abo bonke; abaseleyo babo ngiyakubabulala ngenkemba; obalekayo kubo akayikubaleka, nophunyukayo kubo akayikuphunyuka.
9.2: Noma befohla endaweni yabafileyo, isandla sami siyakubakhipha khona; noma bekhuphukela ezulwini, ngiyakubehlisa khona.
9.3: Noma becasha esiqongweni saseKarmeli, ngiyakubafunisisa, ngibakhiphe khona; nakuba befihlekile emehlweni ami phakathi kolwandle, ngiyakuyala inyoka ukuba iphume khona, ibalume.
9.4: Noma beya ekuthunjweni phambi kwezitha zabo, ngiyakubiza inkemba ukuba iphume khona, ibabulale, ngibeke amehlo ami kubo kube kubi, kungabi kuhle.”
9.5: INkosi uNkulunkulu Sebawoti yiyo ethinta umhlaba, uncibilike, bakhale bonke abakhileyo kuwo; uyakukhukhumala wonke njengeNayile, ubuye ubohle njengomfula waseGibithe;
9.6: yiyona ewakhayo amakamelo ayo aphezulu ezulwini, isekele igobela lawo emhlabeni; yiyona ewabizayo amanzi olwandle, iwathululele ebusweni bomhlaba; nguJehova igama layo.
9.7: “Aninjengabantwana bakwaKushe kimi, nina bantwana bakwa-Israyeli, na?” usho uJehova. “Angikhuphulanga u-Israyeli ezweni laseGibithe, namaFilisti eKafitori, nama-Aramu eKhiri, na?”
9.8: “Bhekani, amehlo eNkosi uJehova akuwo umbuso owonayo; ngiyakuwuchitha ebusweni bomhlaba, ngingachithi nokho ngokupheleleyo indlu kaJakobe,” usho uJehova.
9.9: “Ngokuba bheka, ngiyakuyaleza, ngizulazulise indlu yakwa-Israyeli phakathi kwabo bonke abezizwe, njengalokhu kuhlungwa ngesihlungo, kepha akuyikuwela nembewu eyodwa emhlabathini.
9.10: Zonke izoni zabantu bami ziyakufa ngenkemba, zona ezithi: ‘Okubi akuyikusondela kithina, kusehlele.’ ”
9.11: “Ngalolo suku ngiyakumisa idokodo likaDavide eliwileyo, ngivale imifantu yalo; ngiyakumisa izihlephu zalo, ngilakhe njengasezinsukwini zasendulo,
9.12: ukuze badle ifa lensali yakwa-Edomi nelezizwe zonke ezabizwa ngegama lami,” usho uJehova okwenza lokhu.
9.13: “Bhekani, izinsuku ziyeza,” usho uJehova, “lapho olimayo eyakufica ovunayo, nonyathela izithelo zomvini ohlwanyela imbewu; izintaba ziyakuconsa iwayini, amagquma onke ancibilike.
9.14: Ngiyakubuyisa ukuthunjwa kwabantu bami u-Israyeli, bakhe imizi echithekileyo, bahlale kuyo; bayakutshala izivini, baphuze iwayini lazo; bayakwenza nezivande, badle izithelo zazo.
9.15: Ngiyakubatshala ezweni labo, bangabe besasishulwa ezweni labo engibanike lona,” usho uJehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
